description: §14.8.9 S441 round 4 (F3) — `FROM USERS` names the protected `users` table (SQLite table names are case-insensitive). The row is tagged and extracting the protected column is E-PROTECT-006.
rationale: MEASURED before the fix, ALSO ON MAIN: `SELECT * FROM USERS` emitted no _scrml_protect_tag at all, so even the whole-row runtime strip vanished and the route served {"passwordHash":"SECRET-HASH-123"} (g-protected-column-escapes-redaction-as-scalar, S441 round 4 review).
